tasks.short: Explain facility and attraction rules to customers.

steps.what: Check the applicable facility or attraction rule
Clarify the customer's intended activity and circumstances
Explain rules and practical implications in plain language
Check understanding and resolve remaining questions

tasks.design: Pin attraction-specific approved rule pages in {DOCS} with a visible version and owner. The manager still clarifies, explains and checks understanding personally; the change only shortens finding the correct rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: Rules can be separated across attraction manuals.
tasks.enabler_now: Native indexed links can give direct access to the applicable page.
tasks.still_hard: Exceptions and accessibility needs require contextual judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Explain a restriction respectfully and recognise genuine misunderstanding.
tasks.altitude: Slightly less lookup; customer conversation and authority stay unchanged.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for document access and national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: indexed rule pages reduce document navigation, not the explanation itself.

assumptions: Boundary: oral customer explanation, including occasional rule lookup. No report, record write or written send is inherent here; none is hidden inside the conversation.

Existing policy owners maintain attraction_id, rule_version, effective_date and approved_text. Missing or conflicting rules retain manual lookup and escalation. No model or structured customer capture is needed.
Test native document links first. Shares are provisional work estimates, not prompt prior buckets. Gross 3%; focal link upkeep 0.3 gives net 2.7%.
unknowns: How often managers consult rules rather than know them already
research_questions: Can staff find the current rule without losing its qualifications?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% for familiar rules or existing direct links with no change; 2% when link upkeep costs one hour per 100 baseline hours rather than central 0.3.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Calculate and record departmental expenses and revenue.

steps.what: Retrieve department revenue and expense transactions for the period
Map coded transactions to department reporting lines
Combine department revenue and expense subtotals
Investigate missing codes, refunds and unusual transactions
Check the final period and approve the department summary
Save the approved department summary

tasks.design: Try a native department report in {ERP}, using the booking-system category of {OTHER} only for revenue not already posted. Apply approved code mappings and grouped totals in that view, retaining investigation and final approval with the manager.
tasks.previous_blocker: Managers may still combine departmental totals in a separate worksheet.
tasks.enabler_now: Native report parameters and approved reporting maps can replace that human consolidation.
tasks.still_hard: Refund timing, miscoding and missing postings need investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain an unusual transaction in operational context.

ambition.what: Review departmental expense and revenue completeness at each operating-week close.

tasks.altitude: Less consolidation; spending and ledger correction rights do not change.

build_days.consent_and_access: 2-7 for finance access and national consultation if applicable

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native finance reports can group coded transactions and replace actual manual departmental consolidation.

assumptions: Boundary: departmental summary, excluding till entry, invoice processing and full financial close. The illustrated worksheet consolidation must be confirmed; native calculation runtime earns no saving.

Finance/booking processing already supplies transaction_id, department_code, account_code, posting_date, amount, currency and refund_reference. Finance owns reporting_line mappings. Missing revenue postings retain manual retrieval in s1, not an assumed new feed.
Test native reporting first; s2 flags unmapped items and s4 handles judgement. s6 is near-zero native save at minimum 1% fully retained.
Gross saving 38%; focal report upkeep 1 gives central net 37%.
unknowns: Whether the manager manually consolidates totals today
research_questions: Can a native report reconcile to the actual departmental worksheet?

approvals.approved_version: approved department summary v1 final period, transaction set and totals; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% with an existing complete native summary and no change; 30% if missing postings and code corrections retain seven additional baseline hours versus central net 37%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Interview and hire associates for staff vacancies.

steps.what: Read vacancy requirements and candidate application records
Interview the candidate and explore role suitability
Choose the candidate and verify the selection record
Save the approved candidate selection
Prepare the offer from selected terms and approved clauses
Check final offer wording, terms and candidate destination
Send the approved offer to the candidate

tasks.design: Use a vacancy-linked candidate view and native offer merge in {ATS}, drawing only approved wording from {DOCS}. The manager interviews, chooses and approves the final offer; existing one-click record saves and sends remain manual and earn no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Interview context and offer details may need repeated retrieval and typing.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked views and fixed offer templates can reuse approved terms.
tasks.still_hard: Fair selection and exceptions to approved terms need human decisions and appropriate escalation.
tasks.human_edge: Assess role suitability without substituting a model score for the interview.
tasks.altitude: Less offer assembly; hiring authority and interviews stay unchanged.

reach.learn: Structured interviewing and offer authority limits

build_days.consent_and_access: 3-10 for candidate permissions and applicable national consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native recruitment templates can reuse approved offer terms without automating candidate selection.

assumptions: Boundary: manager vacancy review, interview, selection and routine offer. Candidate time, HR contracting and later onboarding are unchanged outside the focal denominator; no automated screening or staff evaluation.

Existing vacancy records supply vacancy_id, role, hours and approved pay band; applications supply candidate_id and contact. s3 manually selects candidate and offer terms within delegated limits. Missing terms or additional HR approval stop the offer and retain the existing escalation.
Test native views and offer templates first. s5 changes deterministic field merge only. s4/s7 are near-zero native clicks at minimum 1% each, fully retained.
Gross 8%; focal template upkeep 1 gives central net 7%.
unknowns: Offer delegation and HR approval requirements
research_questions: Can offer merging preserve the exact selected terms and approved clauses?

already_counted.description: Approve the final offer and candidate destination

incremental.description: Report stale offer fields and links

approvals.approved_version: approved selection record v1 final candidate and selection rationale; changes void approval
approved offer v1 exact terms, clauses and candidate recipient; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% if linked context and offer merges already exist and no change is made; 5% if unusual offers retain two extra baseline hours versus central net 7%.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assign staff tasks and working hours.

steps.what: Read staff availability, skills and existing commitments
Set activity coverage and applicable working-time constraints
Allocate draft work hours subject to coverage and constraints
Assign specific duties and resolve uncovered or unsuitable allocations
Approve the final duties, hours and staff notification list
Commit the approved duty roster
Send the approved duty roster to the affected staff

tasks.design: Configure the roster category of {OTHER} with reusable coverage rules and a deterministic hours proposal, using existing availability in {HCM}. The manager assigns final duties and resolves exceptions before approving both the committed roster and its staff notification through {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Coverage and working-time rules may be applied manually despite an existing roster engine.
tasks.enabler_now: Native constraint-based proposals can reduce hours allocation without rating staff traits.
tasks.still_hard: Last-minute absences, specialist duties and fair allocation require management judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Resolve practical and interpersonal constraints the stored availability does not capture.

ambition.what: Compare an absence-cover roster before committing a changed activity day.

tasks.altitude: Less initial allocation and mailing; duty decisions and staff discussions remain with the manager.

reach.learn: Working-time rules, skills coverage and roster exceptions

build_days.consent_and_access: 5-20 for availability access and applicable national roster/staff consultation

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: configured roster constraints can propose hours; task suitability and exceptions still need manager review.

assumptions: Boundary: manager preparation, assignment, commit and staff notification. Staff availability updates already occur upstream; no new employee self-service or unpriced transferred work.

Existing records supply employee_id, available_intervals, contracted_hours, skills and existing_shifts. Operations staff maintain activity_id, start/end and staffing need; authorised policy owners supply working-time rules. s2 captures day-specific overrides manually. Missing skills or stale availability stop automatic proposal use.

Test native roster configuration first. s2 saves repeated constraint entry, not coverage judgement; s3 retains proposal inspection, s4 all duty and exception judgement. s6 is a near-zero save at minimum 1%, fully retained; s7 replaces a real separate roster mailing.
Gross saving 29%; focal upkeep 1.5 gives central net 27.5%.
unknowns: Existing roster engine and constraint completeness
research_questions: Does the roster proposal preserve rest, skill coverage and contracted hours under an absence scenario?

already_counted.description: Approve final duties, hours and recipients

incremental.description: Maintain coverage rules and investigate proposal failures

approvals.approved_version: approved duty roster v1 exact duties, hours and employee assignments; changes void approval
approved duty roster v1 exact roster snapshot and affected staff recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 0% for an already-configured roster and notifications with no change; 22% if stale availability and uncovered duties retain 5.5 more baseline hours versus central net 27.5%.

reach: Support workforce planners with checked hours proposals
Explain department variances with management accountants
